description: The ROUNDED MODE IS phrase (the 8-mode set) — ISO 2014+ (§2023:14.7.4); at 85/2002 bare ROUNDED is the single nearest-away-from-zero rounding
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RM.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W PIC 9(3).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
